method: Agent visual review of the encoded MP4 decoded at 2fps through all30s plus35 explicitly selected transition/action frames. Compared complete layouts with pre-render snapshots.
findings: Opening title and official icon clearly visible over paper plate after layering correction.
Input request and source release facts readable during their hold.
Preview opens a distinct authored page; old text does not stretch into the next surface.
Feedback precedes visible v1-to-v2 headline change.
Revised draft remains visible during final CTA and ending.
Clean intentional cuts at4,10,20s; brief entrance fades leave a few minimally populated frames, no prolonged blank segment.
limitations: Sampled review, not uninterrupted audiovisual listening.
No speech or caption synchronization required.
Illustrative workflow, not an authenticated application capture.
